functional_correctness.scope: Bounded integer sum on synthetic fixtures; independent accepted-set and value checks; no claim of truthfulness of a compromised source

authorization_set_hiding.scope: Real BLS12-381 candidate membership test for 1,2,3,5 distinct authorized tags. User approved retaining PFDAM with this claim removed.

report_tag_unlinkability.scope: Physical-sender/entity linkage has not been independently established or ruled out; a report-class dictionary relation is separately documented.

inner_post_quantum_security.scope: Paillier and pairing core remain classical

ml_dsa_integration.scope: Pure ML-DSA-65 plus ECDSA P-256, ALL_REQUIRED on task authorization and aggregate receipt; trusted local role/key/epoch registry; no claim that the pairing core is post-quantum

hybrid_tls_integration.scope: Actual TLS1.3 X25519MLKEM768 negotiation on both role links with mTLS, role identities, no fallback/resumption/0RTT; certificates and handshake authentication remain classical

optimized_paillier_parameter_security.scope: User authorized official abstract fallback after unsuccessful full-text retrieval; concrete optimized-Paillier parameter security remains independently unreviewed; no unified modern security-bit claim

report_tag_confidentiality.scope: With a covering low-entropy dictionary, recovered policy set, degree>=2 and usable nonzero coefficients, the gateway can identify encrypted-report labels. This does not recover readings or identify physical senders.

public_receipt_metadata_verification.scope: V1/V2/V3 external trust, expected task and signed receipt association; UC plaintext remains unsigned for those historical objects. V4 separately includes mandatory UC result statements; status, timing and connection logs remain outside authenticated scope.

online_key_rotation.scope: Actual six-key business signing rotation, current TLS renewal/revocation and signed registry commit recovery; task-boundary updates after active jobs drain, no downgrade. CA/registry root and PFDAM parameter migration remain separate. Software custody, no HSM or human-duty certification.

statistical_release_privacy.scope: Exact release for complete fixed disjoint registered-meter cells, minimum 10 per cell, shared cross-requester/function history, one numeric version per cell/UTC interval. V5 role-derived HMAC-SHA384 binds private inputs/partitions instead of publishing deterministic plaintext hashes. Trusted UC/coordinator, honest registered Sources and OS. Prevents the specified split/revision/duplicate/incomplete/direct-hash-dictionary cases; no arbitrary auxiliary-knowledge, general composition or unique-natural-person privacy guarantee. Process-crash recovery tested; not a power-loss or whole-host rollback guarantee.

uc_result_statement_authentication.scope: V4 independent UC result type binds complete canonical result including value/presentation/count/units and receipt/policy/dataset/slot/epoch/registry; mandatory ECDSA AND ML-DSA-65 and selected SM2. Not public verifiable decryption, source completeness or statistical privacy.

role_secret_storage.scope: Encrypted PKCS#8 active role keys, authenticated role/path-bound new private JSON, independent protected root and one-role pipe; public outputs/fixtures and historical private experiment archives are separate. Trusted OS account/coordinator; no whole-host compromise or all-history confidentiality claim.

management_audit_and_recovery.scope: Different authenticated accounts, one-time bounded approval and protected local chain/anchor; material backup restoration retains current trust and logical deletion. Audit damage recovery records permanent historical gap. Not proof of two natural people, physical zeroization or whole-host disaster recovery.

selected_standard_vectors_and_independen.scope: Selected SM2/SM3/SM4/HKDF standard examples and independent GmSSL 3.2.0 peer; 15 selected public NIST ML-DSA-65 sigVer cases plus same-OpenSSL CLI integration. Peer accepts trailing SM2 signature bytes while application rejects them. No CAVP/module/product certification or independent TLS peer claim.
